_comment: Settings of the front end (read by Vite and by the browser code). No code here. Decisions: D17 (no hardcoded paths), D19 (dev badge), D22 (MapLibre GL JS).

screenshots._comment: Read by frontend/tools/screenshots.mjs (a real browser in Docker). The base URL and the output folder come from the environment variables named here.

browser_checks._comment: Read by frontend/tools/browser_checks.mjs (step 8 done-check: the plan page in real browsers). Environment variables name the site, the screenshot folder, the engine (chromium, firefox or webkit) and an optional computer-installed browser (msedge).

geocoder._comment: Place search (decision D27): Open-Meteo geocoding. ONLY the typed text and the visitor's IP address go to this host; its origin is the single outside host in connect-src of config/headers.conf (a test keeps the two in step). Search runs only when the visitor presses Enter or the button.

check._comment: Read by frontend/tools/plan_check.mjs (checks the browser code on the real exported tiles against the reference made by scripts/plan_reference.py). Same files as config/pipeline.toml [paths] site_dir and plan_reference_file.

colour_scale._comment: Colour for a value at or above the first number of each pair; below the first stop the pixel is transparent. Used by the export (backend/export.py) for the map frames and by the page for the legend.

spike._comment: The spike page (frontend/spikes/maplibre.js) shows one exported frame (file names: config/backend.toml [frames]); replaced by the real map in plan step 9.
